title: Peircean Icon / Index / Symbol Triad
observed_structure: A sign may resemble its referent, bear a causal trace of it, or depend on a learned convention.
Dramatic information changes when a sign shifts between resemblance, evidence, and convention.
transferable_structure: Change how an observable sign connects to its referent—through resemblance, trace, or convention—and make that change alter action or belief.
non_transferable_surface: Do not copy a famous emblem, coded symbol system, or culturally protected sign without provenance and context.
